excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正异常地变暗了。占星专家对此进行讨论后，这种发光减少预计将会影响[This.GetName]上的能源基础设施。
excerpt.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system has anomalously dimmed. After discussing this phenomenon with our astrological specialists, this decline in luminosity is predicted to have a negative effect on the energy infrastructure of [This.GetName].
